gloss: good or bad; merits and demerits

definitions.gloss: good or bad; right or wrong; merits and demerits; quality
definitions.explanation: The relative merit or quality of something, encompassing both its good and bad aspects. Used when evaluating or judging something from multiple angles.

examples.japanese: {善|よ}し{悪|あ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧ことだ。
examples.english: Regardless of whether it's good or bad, it's been decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{善|よ}し{悪|あ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to examine the merits and demerits of this method.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{善|よ}し{悪|あ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}できる→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧になった。
examples.english: He has reached an age where he can judge right from wrong.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used when evaluating something without committing to a judgment: {善|よ}し{悪|あ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (setting aside whether it's good or bad). Also used to talk about the quality of results or outcomes.

WRITING:
Also written as {良|よ}し{悪|あ}し. Both spellings are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {善|よ}し{悪|あ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (regardless of merits)
- {善|よ}し{悪|あ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ (to judge good and bad)
- {善|よ}し{悪|あ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have pros and cons)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {良|りょう}{否|ひ}: pass or fail — more formal, used for evaluation outcomes
- ⟦{是非|ぜひ}→是非：19460_zehi⟧: right and wrong — more formal; also commonly used as an adverb meaning "by all means"
